protocol.truncation: head ceil(max_len/2) + tail floor(max_len/2); right PAD
protocol.final_epochs_rule: median of three best epochs at selected lr
protocol.test_policy: one formal evaluation after final model saved; no retuning
protocol.historical_test_note: post-hoc extension; Test already used by Stage1/2

architecture.initialization: PyTorch default random initialization; PAD embedding zeros
architecture.short_sequences: kernel longer than retained length -> zero activation, position -1
architecture.head_tail_join: convolution may cross join; explanations flag original-position gaps
